headline: Rockstar Games denies firing workers for being unionized
summary: Rockstar Games denied on the final day of a trial in Scotland that it fired employees for union activity. It said they disclosed confidential information about the sixth Grand Theft Auto instalment.
why: Rockstar Games is a subsidiary of Take-Two Interactive, one of the largest video game publishers. Labour disputes at game studios can affect operations and the reputation of the publisher.
original_headline: Rockstar Games niega haber despedido a trabajadores por estar sindicados
